uploads/science/Scipad/Year 9 Book 1/Wor.searchText: WAVES AND ENERGY Using Reflection - Periscopes The periscope is a useful tool. They are commonly used on submarines to see what is above the water while remaining submerged, and were also used by soldiers in World War I and II to look out of the trenches without getting their heads shot off!
